If \(f_{n-1}(x)=\pm k,\) then \(f_n(x)=k-1.\) So if \(f_0(x)=\pm k\) for a nonnegative integer \(k,\) then \(f_k(x)=0,\) after which the sequence alternates \(0,-1,0,\ldots\) Thus \(f_{100}(x)=0\) exactly when \(f_0(x)=2k\) for some integer \(-50\le k\le50.\)

Now \(f_0(x)=x+|x-100|\) \(-|x+100|\) equals \(x+200\) for \(x\lt-100,\) \(-x\) for \(-100\le x\lt100,\) and \(x-200\) for \(x\ge100.\) Its graph is piecewise linear with turning points \((-100,100)\) and \((100,-100).\)

A line \(y=2k\) meets this graph three times for \(-49\le k\le49\) and twice for \(k=\pm50.\) The total is \(99\cdot3+2\cdot2=301.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
